name: fart
description: Fart sounds, songs, cartoons and seasonal surprises in a persistent ChatGPT player.

interface.longDescription:
Disclaimer: this plugin is a prank plugin for entertainment purposes only.
Fart Sounds is a fart sound machine for ChatGPT. Just ask ChatGPT for a fart and enjoy all sorts of botty burps. We have Wet farts, Silent farts and funny farts galore.

WHAT FART SOUNDS DOES:
Plays fart sounds, fart songs and Mr Farts cartoons on request.
Plays a joke fart for your friends. Just ask what sort of fart does Bob (friend's name) make.
Runs fart countdowns: ask for a fart in 10 seconds and surprise your friends!

THE FART SOUNDS PLAYER:
The Fart Sounds player opens right inside your chat with a big fart button you can press. Tap it for a different fart every time.

LIST OF FARTS:
Try asking for one of these...
Long and Crispy, Long and Windy, Cheek Wobbling, Long, Long and Squeaky, Lovely, Smelly, Quick, Quick and Squelchy, Tiny, Small, Deep, Cheeky, Relaxed, Engine Starting, Muffled, Rotten, Engine Rumbler, Trumpet, Wet and Squeaky, Wet, Very Squelchy, Bath, Springy, Guilty, Funny, Pooey, Gassy, Short and Gassy, Very Gassy, Quick Toilet, Silent, Ketchup, Squeaky Balloon, Pushing Hard, Difficult, Very Uncomfortable, Squeaky, Triumphant, 100 farts in a row.

FART MUSIC:
Play Mr Farts first Album!
1. Farting Round The House
2. Reggae Farts
3. Metal Farts
4. Techno Farts
5. Rock Farts
6. Disco Farts
7. Jazz Farts
8. 8 D Farts (stereo farts from all directions, best with headphones)
Plus Mr Farts cartoons!

EXTREME FARTS:
Beethoven, Happy Birthday, Fart Machine Gun, Sir Farts A Lot, Robot, Fly Swatter, Fart Gun, Can't Stop, Toilet, Froggy, Sleeping, Thunderous, Wet and Sassy, Wet and Grumpy, Tight and Fruity, Pants Ripper, Bowel Destroyer.

ANIMAL FARTS:
Unicorn, dinosaur, shark, ghost, alien, dragon, cat, owl, bee, elephant, kangaroo, sheep, fox, goat, dog, lion, whale, dolphin, tiger, hyena, pig, cow, donkey, chicken, duck, goose, horse and fish.

SEASONAL PACKS:
Christmas farts from Santa, plus Easter, Halloween and Valentine's Day farts.

No account or sign-in needed. Fart weather is a joke, not a real forecast, and the plugin never uses your microphone.

With a great fart app comes great responsibility!

positive.description: Play a random fart with no setup
positive.expected_behavior: The Fart Sounds player opens in the chat and plays a random fart sound automatically (if the browser blocks audio, one tap on the player starts it). ChatGPT briefly confirms which fart is playing. Pressing the big button plays a different fart each time.

positive.description: Play a named fart using natural wording
positive.expected_behavior: The player shows "Here comes Wet fart!" and plays the Wet fart sound. Names that are not in the catalogue play a random fart instead of failing.
The player plays a Mr Farts cartoon video and ChatGPT names the cartoon.
The player plays a Mr Farts music video (or audio if video is switched off) and ChatGPT names the song.
The player plays the cow fart from the animal pack and ChatGPT confirms it.

negative.description: Real weather request should not use the joke weather tool
negative.prompt: What's the real weather forecast for London tomorrow?

negative.description: Purchase request: everything is free, nothing to buy
negative.prompt: Buy me the premium fart pack with my Amazon account.
Listen to my microphone and tell me how bad my real fart was.

review.commerce_description: All content is free. The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Player fixes: playback now works in the ChatGPT desktop app, phones ask to Enable sound less often, and a Full screen button keeps the player in front.
